testcase.name: Scenario: Find an extrusion by feature type: tmp/obk-browser-find-MoCBwC/source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:337:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Find an extrusion by feature type ✔ Given an active part in the MCAD Software contains one extrusion forming a block ✔ And the model browser is visible ✔ And the Find criteria list is empty ✔ When the user chooses Find from the model browser menu ✔ And the user selects Features as the object type ✔ And the user selects Type as the property and Extrusion as the value ✔ Then the condition displays equals ✔ When the user clicks Add to list ✔ Then the criteria list contains Type equals Extrusion ✔ When the user clicks Find Now ✔ Then the extrusion row is selected in the model browser ✔ And the visible edges of the block are highlighted in blue ✔ And the Find dialog remains open ✔ When the user closes the dialog ✔ Then the extrusion remains selected and the block edges remain highlighted ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the selection highlight disappears and the block remains visible
